lines.japanese: 「長っげえ便所だなあ？」
lines.english: “That was one hell of a long trip to the john.”

lines.japanese: 「すんません。ちょっと腹の調子が」
lines.english: “Sorry. My stomach was acting up.”

lines.japanese: 俺はヘソの辺りを抑えながら頭を下げた。今度ばかりは嫌味を言われても仕方ない。
lines.english: I bowed with a hand pressed to my belly. This time I could hardly blame him for the jab.

lines.japanese: いまだ監督不在の状態は続いていたけれど、労働意欲の薄いいまどきの若者たちも、さすがに俺が戻ってきたころには全員作業を再開していた。
lines.english: The foreman was still absent, but even the work-shy youth of today had all gone back to work by the time I returned.

lines.japanese: 「無理しねえでいいよ、帰って休んでれば？」
lines.english: “Don't push yourself. Why don't you go home and rest?”

lines.japanese: 男は手を休めずに言った。気遣いには程遠いトーンだった。
lines.english: He said it without pausing in his work. There wasn't a hint of concern in his voice.

lines.japanese: 「いえ、もう全快すから」
lines.english: “Nah. I'm all better now.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そう。じゃあ頑張って」
lines.english: “Oh. Fine. Good luck.”

lines.japanese: やつは俺に背を向けて、ヘルメットの下のデコを袖で拭った。ナマケのくせして、いつの間にかいい汗かいてた。
lines.english: He turned his back on me and wiped the sweat from beneath his hard hat with his sleeve. Lazy bastard or not, somewhere along the way he'd worked up an honest sweat.

lines.japanese: つまり、俺の方がよっぽどナマケだ。
lines.english: Meaning I was the lazier bastard by far.

lines.japanese: 「あの」
「あ、まだいたの？　なに？」
lines.english: “Oh, you're still here? What?”

lines.japanese: 「自分、何すればいいすか」
lines.english: “What should I be doing?”

lines.japanese: 「え、さあ？」
lines.english: “Hell if I know.”

lines.japanese: やつは口元を歪めて「俺に聞くなよ」という顔をした。どうやらヒゲの監督は、飛び込みバイトの用兵を指示しないまま現場を離れたようだ。
lines.english: His mouth twisted into a look that said, *Don't ask me.* Apparently the bearded foreman had left the site without telling anyone how to deploy the day laborer who'd wandered in off the street.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ……そうだなあ、あー……誘導でもやってくんね？」
lines.english: “Then... let's see. Uh... how about directing traffic?”

lines.japanese: 「誘導」
lines.english: “Directing traffic.”

lines.japanese: 交通誘導……のことだよな。だがそれは、警備会社からの派遣員たちに任せている。俺たちの仕事ではないはずだ。
lines.english: Traffic control, he meant. But that was the province of the guards sent by the security company, not us.

lines.japanese: 「なに、やったことねえの？」
lines.english: “What, you've never done it?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、何度かは」
lines.english: “Well, yeah. A few times.”

lines.japanese: 免許は持ってないけどな。
lines.english: Not that I had a license.

lines.japanese: 「だったらおまえ、ちょっと代わってやれよ。きょう警備員ひとりしか来てねえから、あのジイさん休憩取れねえんだよ。どうせこっちは、いまんとこ素人に出来る仕事もねえし」
lines.english: “Then go relieve him for a while. Only one guard showed up today, so that old guy hasn't had a break. Ain't like we've got anything an amateur can do right now anyway.”

lines.japanese: やつは「素人」という言葉を強調した。完全にミソッカス扱いだ。まあ、いい。俺がひとりでブレイクを取りすぎたのは事実だ。仕事で挽回しよう。
lines.english: He leaned hard on the word *amateur*. I was officially the useless extra. Fine. It was true I'd taken more than my share of breaks. I'd make it up in work.

lines.japanese: 「うす」
lines.english: “Yessir.”

lines.japanese: 俺は気合を入れなおして、立ちならぶパイロンの先頭へ走った。
lines.english: I pulled myself together and jogged to the first cone in the line.

lines.japanese: そこは（ドライバー視点で）車線減少区間の始発点。年老いた警備員が、迫りくるヘッドライトたちと正面から向かいあっていた。
lines.english: From a driver's point of view, it marked the beginning of the lane closure. An elderly security guard stood face-to-face with the oncoming tide of headlights.

lines.japanese: 反射材と発光ダイオードがちかちか瞬いてる真夜中の安全ベストは、こんな還暦過ぎたじいさんが着てると赤いチャンチャンコに見えないこともない。
lines.english: On a man past sixty, the safety vest—reflectors and LEDs blinking in the midnight dark—could almost have passed for the red sleeveless coat traditionally worn to mark a sixtieth birthday.

lines.japanese: 頭上に掲げたオレンジ色の誘導灯がきびきび振れる。右から左、左から右。なんだか工業ロボットみたいな動きの、健康そうだけど覇気がないじいさんだった。
lines.english: The orange baton held over his head swept briskly from right to left, then left to right. He looked healthy enough, but had all the spirit of an industrial robot.

lines.japanese: 「あの」
lines.english: “Excuse me.”

lines.japanese: クルマの波が途切れた隙に呼びかけて、若い作業員からの指示を伝えた。じいさんはしわがれた声で礼を述べると、俺にベストと誘導灯といくらかの説明とを託し、近所の牛丼屋へ消えた。
lines.english: I called to him during a break in the cars and relayed the young worker's instructions. The old man thanked me in a rasp, entrusted me with the vest, the baton, and a few pointers, then vanished into a nearby beef-bowl joint.

lines.japanese: 「おーし。やってやんぜ、クソが」
lines.english: “All right. Let's do this, goddammit.”

lines.japanese: 俺は受けとった重い塩化ビニールを、さっそく頭からすっぽり被った。Ｖ字状に並んだ発光ダイオードがちかちか、ぴかぴか。なんだか大昔の歌番組みたいだ。
lines.english: I promptly pulled the heavy vinyl vest down over my head. The V-shaped rows of LEDs flashed and sparkled. I looked like something out of an ancient television music show.

lines.japanese: どんなファッション雑誌にも載ってない、ワークウェア・スタイルのきわみ。俺は輝く衣をまとって、ひとり最前線に立った。
lines.english: The ultimate in workwear chic, featured in no fashion magazine on earth. Clad in raiment of light, I took my solitary place on the front line.

lines.japanese: 横に三台並んで突っこんでくるダンプとＲＶとスポーツクーペが、俺の右腕一本で水族館のイルカみたいにたちまちフォーメーションを変える。
lines.english: A dump truck, an SUV, and a sports coupe came charging three abreast, then changed formation at one sweep of my right arm like trained dolphins at an aquarium.

lines.japanese: 頭上には大型車とどろくハイウェイ。腹にひびく削岩ドリルの３２ビート。ちょっと無骨なペンライトをメトロノームよろしく揺らしながら、俺はぼろいスニーカーの爪先で即興のリズムを刻む。
lines.english: Heavy trucks thundered along the expressway overhead. A pneumatic drill hammered a thirty-two-beat rhythm through my gut. Swinging my rugged little glow stick like a metronome, I tapped out an improvisation with the toe of my battered sneaker.

lines.japanese: もしこれがミュージカルだったら、現場のあんちゃんら交えて自由気ままに踊りだす場面だ。かなり爽快だろ。
lines.english: If this were a musical, this would be where the guys on the site and I burst into a wild, carefree dance. It would feel pretty damn good.

lines.japanese: うるせえな、いいんだよ、動いてないと寒みぃんだよ。
lines.english: Shut up. I had to keep moving or I'd freeze my ass off.

lines.japanese: それから数十分後。
lines.english: A while later—

lines.japanese: 午前１時を回り、さすがに交通量もだいぶ減ったころのことだった。
lines.english: It was past one in the morning, and even the traffic had finally thinned out.

lines.japanese: ディスチャージヘッドランプの嘘くさいほど青白い光と、いかにも違法改造ぶっちぎりなスポーツマフラーの排気音が、濃密な夜を切りさきながら非常識な速度で接近してきた。
lines.english: The unnaturally blue-white glare of high-intensity discharge headlamps and the roar of a sports muffler that positively screamed illegal modification came slicing through the dense night at an idiotic speed.

lines.japanese: 白いワンボックスだ。でかでか掲げられた矢印標識も、びかびか光る俺の合図灯も、ことごとく見事にガン無視して、わざわざ封鎖レーンめがけ突っ込んでくる。
lines.english: A white minivan. It blithely ignored both the enormous arrow sign and my blazing signal baton, aiming straight for the closed lane.

lines.japanese: 迫りくるパールホワイトの車体──近未来映画にでも出てきそうなカプセルっぽいフォルム──は、残念ながら俺が数時間ほど前に見たばかりのものだった。
lines.english: Unfortunately, I recognized the pearl-white body bearing down on me—that capsule-shaped silhouette out of some near-future movie. I'd seen it only a few hours ago.

lines.japanese: 「あいつら……なに戻ってきてんだよ……」
lines.english: “Those assholes... What the hell are they doing back here?”

lines.japanese: フロントガラス越しにふたつの影が見える。運転席には巨体のスキンヘッド。助手席にはロンゲ。後部席にも同乗者の影がいくつかチラついていた。
lines.english: Two shapes showed through the windshield: a gigantic skinhead behind the wheel, Longhair in the passenger seat. Several more shadows flickered in the rear.

lines.japanese: 不意にタイヤが甲高く鳴いて、迫りくる青白い二ツ眼はじゃれるように左右へ振れだした。クルマはあぶなっかしく蛇行しながら、しかし速度を落とすことなくぐんぐん近づいてくる。
lines.english: The tires suddenly shrieked, and the pair of blue-white eyes bearing down on me began wagging playfully from side to side. The van weaved dangerously but kept coming, never shedding speed.

lines.japanese: 「ラリった運転してんじゃねーよ、デブが」
lines.english: “Quit driving like you're high, fatass.”

lines.japanese: だが逃げるのも癪だ。俺は一歩も引かないまま、真横に倒した誘導灯の両端をそれぞれ握り、腕いっぱい前へ突きだした。こっち来んな、封鎖中、封鎖中、封鎖中！
lines.english: But running would piss me off. I stood my ground, gripped the baton sideways by both ends, and thrust it out at arm's length. Don't come any closer. Lane closed, lane closed, lane closed!

lines.japanese: しかしイカれたドライバーは明らかに俺の停止命令を視認していながら、ブレーキペダルに触れる様子すら見せない。
lines.english: The lunatic driver plainly saw my order to stop, yet showed no sign of so much as touching the brake.
“Whooooo!”

lines.japanese: ナビシートの糞ロンゲ、つまり森里和馬が、天井のルーフから顔と両手を突きだしてアタマのゆるい奇声を発した。うざい髪が突風にたなびく。
lines.english: The long-haired shitbag in the passenger seat—Kazuma Morisato—stuck his face and both hands out through the sunroof and loosed a moronic howl. His obnoxious hair streamed in the gale.

lines.japanese: 「全速前進！　ヨーソロォー！」
lines.english: “Full speed ahead! Steady as she goes!”

lines.japanese: 「っせーな、絶叫したいなら遊園地行けこの──」
lines.english: “Shut up. If you wanna scream, go to an amusement park, you—”

lines.japanese: しかし俺の毒々しいつぶやきは、あらゆる騒音に呑みこまれた。
lines.english: But every other noise swallowed my venomous mutter.

lines.japanese: 白々しい急ブレーキとスリップの音を撒きちらし、銀色の車体が俺の身体からギリギリ数十センチ手前で、震えるように停止した。
lines.english: With a flagrantly theatrical screech of brakes and skidding tires, the silver body shuddered to a stop bare inches from mine.

lines.japanese: 「イェア、また会ったなファッキン成田君！」
lines.english: “Yeah! We meet again, fucking Narita!”

lines.japanese: 「……っぶねーな、てめえ」
lines.english: “...Watch it, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 俺は白い息もろとも吐きすてた。サブウーハー効きまくりのカーオーディオが、しわがれ声の絶叫としか思えない破滅的なスラッシュメタル（運転手の趣味じゃなさそうだ）を撒きちらしていた。
lines.english: I spat the words out with a cloud of white breath. The car stereo, subwoofer cranked, was spewing ruinous thrash metal that sounded like nothing but hoarse screaming. It didn't strike me as the driver's taste.

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんな、ちょっぴり驚いちゃったじゃねーかコノヤロウ。ブレーキは目標の３０メートル手前から踏んどけハゲ。ＡＢＳ過信してんじゃねーぞ、こン暴走ブタ」
lines.english: “The fuck is wrong with you? You almost startled me a little, asshole. Hit the brakes thirty meters before your target, Cue Ball. Don't put so much faith in your ABS, you runaway pig.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハ」
lines.english: “Hahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「かかかかか」
lines.english: “Kakakakaka!”

lines.japanese: げらげら笑いながら（何もおかしくねえよ）、皇帝とその従者がクルマから降りてきた。
lines.english: Roaring with laughter—nothing was funny—the emperor and his retainer climbed out of the car.

lines.japanese: 鳳翔は運転席の開けはなたれた窓枠に悠然と肘をかけ、フレイムバーズのハンドサイン（天翔ける炎の猛禽、らしいよ）をゆったり目の横に掲げた。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori lounged against the open driver’s-side window and raised the Flame Birds’ hand sign beside one eye: a fiery bird of prey soaring through the heavens, or so the story went.

lines.japanese: 「ようアミーゴ、久しいな」
lines.english: “Amigo. It has been too long.”

lines.japanese: 相も変わらず、掠れた声でねちっこく語る芝居がかった口調。その瞳は今日もジャケ写のＡＶ女優みたいに爛々と輝いていた。
lines.english: The same theatrical drawl as ever, every word drawn sticky and slow through that rasp. His eyes glittered today, too, like those of a porn actress on the cover of a video.

lines.japanese: 「ようじゃねーだろ、てめ。夜分遅くに何はしゃいでんだよ。近隣のご迷惑じゃねーかコノヤロウ。赤ちゃんとか起きちゃうだろ」
lines.english: “Don't amigo me, asshole. What're you doing raising hell at this hour? People live around here, you know. You'll wake somebody's baby, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 俺は職務にのっとり夜間走行のマナーを説いた。鳳は何も答えず運転手に顎を振って無言の命令を発した。ダジャレ好きのハゲは慣れた手付きでオーディオの音量を下げる。ツーと言えばカー、見事な主従関係だ。
lines.english: Doing my duty, I lectured them on nighttime driving etiquette. Otori answered with a silent jerk of his chin at the driver. The pun-loving Cue Ball lowered the stereo with practiced ease. One twitch, and the other moved. A master and servant in perfect accord.

lines.japanese: 皇帝陛下は例によって今宵も泥酔しているご様子。据わりの悪い首を奇妙に傾けた姿勢から、俺の姿──パチンコ屋のネオンサインさながらに点滅する交通誘導員──を見下ろして言った。
lines.english: His Imperial Majesty appeared, as usual, to be blind drunk this evening. His neck sat strangely askew, as if it had come loose, while he looked down at me—a traffic marshal blinking like the neon sign outside a pachinko parlor—and spoke.

lines.japanese: 「なあ和馬ァ、やつと逢えない時間は俺を孤独の深淵に陥れていたのか？　ひと月ぶりに再会する友が、ひときわ目映く見えるんだがなあ……」
lines.english: “Tell me, Kazuma... did my time apart from him cast me into the abyss of solitude? The friend I meet again after a month seems to shine more brilliantly than ever...”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、働く男はいつだって輝いてんだよ。ちったあ俺を見習えこの糞ニート共」
lines.english: “Shut up. A working man always shines. You useless unemployed fucks oughta take a lesson from me.”

lines.japanese: だが鳳は俺の言葉に失笑を漏らし、大仰に顎をそびやかした。
lines.english: But Otori gave a derisive snort and lifted his chin with theatrical grandeur.

lines.japanese: 「なあ和馬ァ、自分だけが白鳥だと信じているあの家鴨は誰だ？」
lines.english: “Tell me, Kazuma... who is that duck who alone believes himself a swan?”

lines.japanese: 「はーい！　アルバイトひとつまともに続けられない、バリバリ無職の成田隼人くんでーす！」
lines.english: “Ooh, I know! It’s Hayato Narita, unemployed as hell and unable to hold down even one measly part-time job!”

lines.japanese: 森里が運転席に身を乗りだして、前照灯をハイビームに切りかえた。
lines.english: Morisato leaned toward the driver’s seat and switched the headlights to high beam.

lines.japanese: 押しよせる光の照射。俺はサーチライトに照らしだされた脱走兵みたいに、顔の前へてのひらをかざさなければならなかった。
lines.english: Light came crashing over me. Like a deserter caught in a searchlight, I had to raise a palm before my face.

lines.japanese: 「てめ……消せ馬鹿、照明なら自家発電で間に合ってんだよ。輝いてんだよ俺。磨きかけのダイヤなんだよ」
lines.english: “You asshole... Turn that off, idiot. I generate all the light I need. I'm already shining. I'm a diamond in the rough.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、つーか消さなくていいから消えろ。邪魔なんだよロンゲ。あと髪切れ髪」
lines.english: “Actually, forget turning it off. Just fuck off. You're in the way, Longhair. And cut your damn hair.”

lines.japanese: 「かかか、イイヨイイヨ～、キレた顔もかわイイヨ～」
lines.english: “Kakaka, good, good! You're so cute when you're mad!”

lines.japanese: 森里がケータイのレンズを向けながら笑う。俺は腕をひと振りして無断撮影のカメラマンを脇へさばいた。
lines.english: Morisato laughed as he pointed his phone camera at me. One sweep of my arm sent the unauthorized cameraman off to the side.

lines.japanese: 「キレてねーよ、仕事なんだよ。円滑な交通を確保すんのが仕事なの。こんなとこ停めんなハゲ、天下の国道ド真ん中だっつーの」
lines.english: “I'm not mad. I'm working. My job is to keep traffic moving smoothly. Don't park here, Cue Ball. You're in the middle of a goddamn national highway.”

lines.japanese: 「ドント・ストロングだぜ成田君、融通利かせようや。股間にクモの巣張っちまった山寺のシスターじゃあるめえに、そう固てえこと言わなくたっていいじゃねえか。どうせここは封鎖してる車線だろ？」
lines.english: “Don’t strong, Narita. Loosen up. You don’t gotta be so stiff unless you’re some nun up a mountain with cobwebs on her crotch. This lane’s closed anyway, ain’t it?”

lines.japanese: 「オメーらのために封鎖してるわけじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “It's not closed for you assholes.”

lines.japanese: 深夜の環状道路、途切れ途切れにやって来る通行車両は、誘導員の指示なんてなくても、どうせ標識やバリケードに気付いて勝手に封鎖車線を避けてゆく。
lines.english: On the ring road after midnight, the occasional car saw the signs and barricades for itself and moved out of the closed lane without any help from a traffic marshal.

lines.japanese: まあ、ただの車線減少だし、すでに渋滞が起こるような時間でもない。言ってしまえば、もともと俺の必要性なんて薄かったんだ。しかし金をもらう以上、与えられた職務は勤勉にこなさなければならない。当然だろ？
lines.english: I mean, it was only a lane reduction, and it was already too late for traffic. They barely needed me here to begin with. Still, if you're getting paid, you do the job you're given and do it properly. Obviously, right?

lines.japanese: 「なーんだよなー。おまえの数少ないお友達が、陣中見舞いに駆けつけてやってんだぜー？　すこしは感謝しとけってー」
lines.english: “Aw, come on. Some of your precious few friends came all this way to cheer you on at the front. You could show a little gratitude.”

lines.japanese: 森里はヘラヘラ笑っていたが、しばらく俺が無言のまま睨んでいたら、何かぶつくさ言いながらもライトをローに戻した。
lines.english: Morisato kept grinning like an idiot, but after I glared at him in silence for a while, he muttered something under his breath and dipped the lights again.
“Otori.”

lines.japanese: 雑兵にいくら言っても意味がない。俺は悪の親玉に誘導灯を振って、失せろと命じた。しかし鳳はうちわで扇がれたような涼しい顔で、まったく関係ない答えを返してきた。
lines.english: There was no point talking to the rank and file. I waved my baton at the criminal mastermind and ordered him gone. Without breaking his composure, Otori replied with something entirely unrelated.

lines.japanese: 「妹が世話になったらしいなァ」
lines.english: “I hear you looked after my sister.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は胸ポケットから煙草を一本引きぬき口元へ運ぶ。すかさず森里が火を点けた。
lines.english: Otori drew a cigarette from his breast pocket and brought it to his lips. Morisato immediately lit it for him.

lines.japanese: 「礼は言わねえぞ。もはや俺が、そういった義理や権利を持たないのは分かるだろォ……」
lines.english: “I won't thank you. You understand that I no longer possess either the obligation or the right...”

lines.japanese: 鳴の兄は苦笑いのひとつも見せずに、吸いこんだ煙をゆっくり吐きだした。注意してよくよく見れば、たしかに妹とは目元のあたりに共通点があった。
lines.english: Naru's brother slowly exhaled the smoke he'd drawn in, without so much as a rueful smile. Looking closely, I could see that he and his sister did share something around the eyes.

lines.japanese: 「いいけどおまえ、あんまガキに夜遊びさせんな。最近の強姦魔は意外とストライクゾーン広れぇぞ」
lines.english: “Fine, but don't let the kid run around at night so much. Rapists these days have a surprisingly wide strike zone.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　せっかくだが、そういった忠言は俺の管轄外だ。やつの保護者にでも言え」
lines.english: “Hah! Regrettably, such counsel lies outside my jurisdiction. Address it to her guardian.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｈｕｈ、そんなこと言ってよう成田君、あんたこそ実はリルシスタに手ぇ付けたりしてんじゃないのかい」
lines.english: “Huh. Big words, Narita, but maybe you've actually been putting the moves on li'l sister yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「アホか、んなわけねーだろ」
lines.english: “Don't be stupid. Course I haven't.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで間が空くんだよ。なんだァおい、ちっとやましいトコあんじゃねーの」
lines.english: “What was that pause for? What's this, huh? Got something to feel guilty about?”

lines.japanese: 「やま、やましくねーっつの馬鹿」
lines.english: “G-guilty? I told you, I'm not, idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで噛むんだよ。動揺すんなよ」
lines.english: “What're you tripping over your words for? Don't get flustered.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、まさかあんた、ほんとに……」
lines.english: “Y-you don't mean you really...”

lines.japanese: 「ほう？」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 「ほうじゃねーよ、違げーつってんだろ、こんクソ共。あんな？　言わせてもらうけど、俺の好みは妖艶な色香ただよう女豹のような女だから」
lines.english: “Don't ‘oh’ me. I said you're wrong, you pack of assholes. For your information, my type is a woman like a panther, dripping with sultry allure.”

lines.japanese: 「ジーザス！　こいつぁヤベえぜ翔くん。あんたのリルシスタは、あと二年したらかなりに女豹だ。間違いねえ、こないだ本人が言ってたからな」
lines.english: “Jesus! We got trouble, Kakeru. Give your li'l sister two years and she'll be one hell of a panther. No question. She told me so herself the other day.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、信じんなよ」
lines.english: “Why the hell would you believe her?”

lines.japanese: 「二ヵ年計画の青田買いか。いい趣味をしている」
lines.english: “A two-year plan to buy the crop while it's green. You have exquisite taste.”

lines.japanese: 「信じるなっつの、おめーも兄馬鹿だな。いや、むしろバカ兄だな」
lines.english: “I said don't believe it. A doting brother? No, you're just a stupid brother.”

lines.japanese: 「言ったな成田。じゃあおまえ、ぜってえナルタローにヘンなことすんじゃねーぞ」
lines.english: “You heard yourself, Narita. That means you better not do anything funny to Narutaro.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえよ、てめーのオンナにヘンなことすんぞ」
lines.english: “Shut up, or I'll do something funny to your woman.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、亜衣は関係ねーだろ亜衣はァ！」
lines.english: “H-hey, Ai's got nothing to do with this! Leave Ai out of it!”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、せっかく俺らが絡みに来てやったのに、なんか成田君ピリピリしてねーかあ？」
lines.english: “Come on, Narita. We went out of our way to come mess with you, and you seem kinda prickly tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　そうでもねえよなあ隼人？　それがおまえのスタンダードだよなあ？」
lines.english: “Hah! He doesn't seem any different to me. Isn't this your standard setting, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　あー、そりゃ、てめえらみたいのは素でウゼーからな。それともなんだ、おまえは台所にゴキブリが出るたんびいちいちキレてんのか」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, yeah, guys like you are just naturally fucking annoying. What, do you lose your shit every time a cockroach shows up in your kitchen?”

lines.japanese: 「クックック」
lines.english: “Kukukuku.”

lines.japanese: そこでまた鳳は、俺に視点を据えたまま声だけを助手席に放った。
lines.english: Otori kept his eyes fixed on me and spoke to the passenger seat without turning his head.

lines.japanese: 「なあ和馬、こういう男が本気でたぎらせたツラを見たいと思わないか？」
lines.english: “Tell me, Kazuma. Don't you want to see the face a man like this makes when his blood truly boils?”

lines.japanese: 「えぇー？　いやあ、べつに自分は……」
lines.english: “Huh? Uh, I can't say I really...”

lines.japanese: 「ヴァガヤロおまえ、想像してみろよォ。あの冷めきった面の皮が引っくりかえって、シビれるような極上の目ン玉が光る瞬間をよォ。ハハ、ハハハハ！　エレクトすんぜええええ？」
lines.english: “Dumbass, use your imagination. Picture that ice-cold face turned inside out—the instant those exquisite, electrifying eyes blaze to life. Hah... hahahaha! It gets you hard, doesn't it?”

lines.japanese: そして相変わらず言ってることが意味プーだった。
lines.english: And, as ever, what he was saying meant precisely jack shit.

lines.japanese: 「はいはい。分かったから、もう帰りなさいキミたち」
lines.english: “Sure, sure. I get it. Now run along home, boys.”

lines.japanese: 現場のあんちゃん達はこの状況をどう思っているだろう。もし聞かれることがあれば、どこかの酔っぱらった馬鹿に絡まれていたと説明しよう。
lines.english: I wondered what the other guys on the site made of all this. If anyone asked, I'd explain that some drunken idiots had wandered up and started harassing me.

lines.japanese: くそ、今日の俺はこんなんばっかだ。ダセぇ。あいつらにケチつける権利ねえよ。
lines.english: Fuck. This kind of shit kept happening to me today. Lame. Who was I to give those guys crap?

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ、そんな、いいじゃない隼人。まだみんな来たばっかりなんでしょ」
lines.english: “Now, now. There's no harm in it, Hayato. Everyone only just got here.”

lines.japanese: 「まだじゃねえよ、長居する前提で来てんじゃねえよ、オカン口調でほざいてんじゃねえよ。つか、おまえら、野次馬感覚でワケもなくひとの職場冷やかしに来んのとかやめてくんない」
lines.english: “Don't ‘only just got here’ me. Don't assume you're staying. And quit talking like my mother. Seriously, could you people stop dropping by my workplace like rubberneckers just to heckle me for no goddamn reason?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、さっき撮ったおまえの動画、ヘテロで翔さんに見しててー。したらなんか、急に会いたくなったとか言いだしちゃってー」
lines.english: “Nah, I was showing Kakeru that video I took of you back at Hetero, and then, like, he suddenly started saying he wanted to see you...”

lines.japanese: 「来る理由にならねえか？」
lines.english: “That not reason enough?”

lines.japanese: 「なるわけねーだろ。遠距離恋愛中の乙女か、てめえは。つか、むしろストーカーじゃねーかこれ。やめろ変質者、婦人弁護士会に無料相談とかすんぞ」
lines.english: “Of course it isn't. What are you, some maiden pining through a long-distance romance? Hell, this is straight-up stalking. Back off, creep, or I'll call a women's legal hotline.”
“Kuku...”

lines.japanese: 鳳は締まりのない唇を隠すように、指の深いところで挟んだ煙草を口へ運んだ。いや、運ぶな。ごゆっくりしてるトキじゃねーよ。
lines.english: As if to hide his slack lips, Otori raised the cigarette clamped deep between his fingers to his mouth. No, don't. This isn't the time to be taking it easy.

lines.japanese: 「いやホントごめんなさい。てめえらマジ消えてください。ぼくお仕事中なんです」
lines.english: “No, really, I'm terribly sorry. You assholes, please seriously disappear. Little old me is trying to work.”

lines.japanese: 「ドンハフトゥ・ウォーリィ、心配は無用だぜファッキン便利屋。いいじゃねえか、ここクビんなったらＹＦＢで傭兵でもやりゃーよう。なあ皇帝」
lines.english: “Don’t have to worry—no need to worry, fuckin’ handyman. If they fire you from this gig, you can always sign on as a YFB mercenary. Ain’t that right, Emperor?”

lines.japanese: 「クク、そうだな……おまえひとりぐらい俺が養ってもいい」
lines.english: “Kuku... Indeed. I suppose I could afford to keep one man like you.”

lines.japanese: 「もうええっつーの。そらさっき断ったっつーの」
lines.english: “Enough already, I'm telling you. I told you I turned that down earlier.”

lines.japanese: 「つか、おまえらこのあと、またしょーもねえ鬼退治だってな。アホくせえ。あんま妹が恥ずかしがることしてやんなよ。いい大人なんだから、もっとマシな遊びあんだろ」
lines.english: “Besides, I hear you're off on another stupid ogre hunt after this. What a load of crap. Try not to do anything that'll embarrass your sister. You're grown men. Find a better way to play.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Hah!”

lines.japanese: 至極まっとうなことを言った俺に、鳳は太い煙と嘲笑を吹きかけた。
lines.english: In answer to my perfectly reasonable remarks, Otori blew a thick cloud of smoke and scorn in my face.

lines.japanese: 「なあ隼人、俺たちはいつからガキじゃなくなったんだろうなあ」
lines.english: “Hey, Hayato... when did we stop being kids?”

lines.japanese: 「知らねえよ。そんな十代御用達の青春ロックみたいな話はしてねえよ。俺は仕事の邪魔すんなっつってんだ糞ニート、ひとの話を聞け」
lines.english: “Hell if I know. I’m not asking for some youth-rock lyric written for teenagers. I said stop getting in the way of my work, you unemployed asshole. Try listening.”

lines.japanese: 「クク、声が届いてないのは貴様の方だろ。ああ、いいぜえ、俺たちと遊びたくなったらいつでも迎えいれてやるよ」
lines.english: “Kuku. You're the one whose voice isn't reaching anybody. Yeah, fine. If you ever feel like playing with us, we'll take you in anytime.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえよ。ほざいてねーで早くどかせって、このヤンキーワゴン」
lines.english: “Shut up. Quit babbling and move this delinquent-mobile already.”

lines.japanese: 爪先で前輪をド突く。衝撃は分厚いゴムに吸いこまれたが、それを見た鳳の目が糸のようにすぼまった。
lines.english: I drove my toe into the front tire. The thick rubber swallowed the blow, but Otori's eyes narrowed to slits at the sight.

lines.japanese: 「頑ななハヤブサだァ……」
lines.english: “A stubborn Falcon...”

lines.japanese: 「やかましい。ガンとばしてる暇あったら、さっさとクルマ出せ無職ども」
lines.english: “Can it. If you've got time to glare at me, you've got time to move the car, you jobless bastards.”

lines.japanese: おんぼろスニーカーで、今度はフェンダーをひと突きした。
lines.english: This time I jabbed the fender with my battered sneaker.
“Aaaah!”

lines.japanese: 車体が揺れるほどの力は込めなかったが、それでも丹念に磨かれたメタルスキンには醜い傷痕がかすかに残った。
lines.english: I hadn't kicked hard enough to rock the car, but a faint, ugly scar remained on the painstakingly polished metal skin.

lines.japanese: 「てっ……ててて、てンめえ！　ひとのクルマ、何すんだコラアッ！？」
lines.english: “Y-y-y-you bastard! What the hell are you doing to my car?!”

lines.japanese: 「いいんだよ、降りてこねーでいンだよ駄洒落ブタ。おいニワトリ、さっさとクルマ出させろ」
lines.english: “Stay in there, Pun Pig. Nobody asked you to get out. Hey, Chicken. Make him move the car.”

lines.japanese: がんっ。動こうとしない鉄の箱をもう一度蹴りつける。
lines.english: Clang. I kicked the motionless steel box again.
“Nooooo!”

lines.japanese: 「駐車料金。５秒に一回ヘコまします」
lines.english: “Parking fee. I'll put in one dent every five seconds.”

lines.japanese: がんっ。言いながらプラス一発。さらに黒い爪先を振りかぶって、相手の反応を待った。
lines.english: Clang. One more to punctuate the announcement. Then I drew my black sneaker back again and waited for their response.

lines.japanese: 「ヤロウ……」
lines.english: “You bastard...”

lines.japanese: 痺れを切らしたのはワゴンのオーナーでも、無敵の皇帝陛下でもなく、もっとも格下の森里だった。
lines.english: The first to lose patience was neither the van's owner nor His Invincible Imperial Majesty, but Morisato, the lowest man on the ladder.

lines.japanese: 「いつまでも好き勝手やりァがって……いいかげん調子こきすぎだろ」
lines.english: “You've done whatever the hell you wanted long enough... You're getting way too full of yourself.”

lines.japanese: 立場的にそうする義務があるんだろうか。やつは眉を八の字に吊り、掠れ声を漏らして俺を挑発した。
lines.english: Maybe his station obliged him to do it. He drew his brows into a strained inverted V and rasped out a challenge.

lines.japanese: 「言っとくけどなァ、おまえに好き勝手させてンのは、おまえが怖ぇーからじゃねェぞ。そこんとこ勘違いすんな、アァ？　俺がその気ンなりゃあ、てめえらなんざ一生陽の当たらねえとこに沈め──」
lines.english: “Get one thing straight. We don't let you do whatever you want because we're scared of you. Don't get that twisted, hear me? If I felt like it, I could sink punks like you someplace the sun would never shine—”

lines.japanese: 「──やめろ」
lines.english: “Enough.”

lines.japanese: しかし森里が俺の体に掴みかかるのと、鳳が片腕一本でそれを制したのはほぼ同時だった。
lines.english: Morisato lunged to grab me at almost the exact moment Otori stopped him with one arm.

lines.japanese: 「がふっ！」
lines.english: “Ghk!”

lines.japanese: 不動の鳳の左手だけが真横に伸び、親指を下にして森里の喉首に絡みついていた。
lines.english: Only Otori's left hand had moved, shooting straight out and closing around Morisato's throat, thumb pointed down.

lines.japanese: 「驚いたぞ和馬ァ……おまえはいつから、俺の断りなしに口を利けるほど偉くなったんだァ……？」
lines.english: “I am surprised, Kazuma... When did you become important enough to speak without my permission?”

lines.japanese: 「ずっ、ずいま……ぜん……」
lines.english: “S-sor... ry...”

lines.japanese: 「生きいそぐな……俺たちみてえな凡骨は、風を待たなけりゃ楽園には行けないんだよ……」
lines.english: “Do not race through your life... Mediocrities such as we can never reach paradise without waiting for the wind...”

lines.japanese: 「くっ……かはっ……」
lines.english: “Ghk... khah...”

lines.japanese: 森里は痛ましくうめいたが、あるじに対して抵抗の素振りはまったく見せなかった。背中をワゴン車の側面に張りつけられたまま全身を強張らせて苦痛に耐えるさまは、どこか健気でさえあった。
lines.english: Morisato groaned in pain but made no attempt to resist his master. Pinned against the side of the van, every muscle rigid as he endured the agony, he looked almost touchingly loyal.

lines.japanese: 「隼人……おまえも今を愉しめ……」
lines.english: “Hayato... you, too, should savor the present...”

lines.japanese: 鳳の頭が、夢の中を泳ぐようにぐらりと傾いた。蕩けるような薄笑いが俺を見下ろしてくる。
lines.english: Otori’s head lolled as if drifting through a dream. A faint, almost rapturous smile hovered over me.

lines.japanese: 「ククク、俺はとびきりの嵐を待っちゃあいるが……今は今の微風を愉しむことにしてるぜえ……前戯が濃厚なほど、達したときの快感もひとしおだからなァ……」
lines.english: “Kukuku. I may be waiting for one magnificent storm... but for now, I choose to savor the breeze at hand. The richer the foreplay, the sweeter the ecstasy when release finally comes...”

lines.japanese: 気味悪いほど瞳孔の黒さが際立つ瞳。右手には紫煙の立ちのぼる煙草。言葉を止めた唇と仲間を絞めあげる左手が、熱を帯びたように細かく震えていた。
lines.english: The black of his pupils stood out with eerie intensity. A cigarette trailed violet smoke from his right hand. His closed lips and the left hand crushing his comrade’s throat trembled as though feverish.

lines.japanese: 「っ……かはっ……ふっ……！」
lines.english: “Ghk... khah... hnh...!”

lines.japanese: 気道を塞がれた森里の顔はやがて赤みを帯びはじめ、こめかみには血管が浮きでていた。他方、鳳は煙草を悠然と一息吸って、吐いた。
lines.english: With Morisato’s airway blocked, his face slowly reddened and veins rose at his temples. Otori, meanwhile, took a leisurely drag from his cigarette and breathed it out.

lines.japanese: 「なあ隼人、そう死にいそぐな……もっと俺にかまけろよ……」
lines.english: “Hayato... don't be in such a hurry to die. Pay more attention to me...”

lines.japanese: 俺は露骨に眉をひそめて首をひねった。
lines.english: I cocked my head, making no effort to hide my frown.

lines.japanese: 「相ッ変わらず、おまえの言ってることは、どれもこれも漏れなく意味が分かんねえ」
lines.english: “Same as ever. I don’t understand one goddamn thing you say.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、いい、いい。解説とかしなくていいから。も、一秒でも早く帰って。ほんとバイト代に響くから。あとそのロンゲすげー痛そうだから、そろそろ放し──」
lines.english: “No, no, it's fine. I don't need an explanation. Just go home already. One second sooner if you can. You're seriously cutting into my pay. And Longhair looks like he's in serious pain, so maybe let him—”

lines.japanese: 「──仕事熱心だなァ。欲しいものがあるなら俺が与えてやってもいいんだぜえ」
lines.english: “Such devotion to your work. If there is something you desire, I could provide it.”

lines.japanese: 「そーゆー問題じゃねえだろ。熱心とか関係なくて、お仕事ってのはフツー一生懸命やるもんだろ」
lines.english: “That's not the point. Devotion's got nothing to do with it. When you have a job, you're supposed to work hard. That's normal.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！　立派な心構えだ、結果が伴わないのは気の毒だがなあ」
lines.english: “Hahaha! An admirable philosophy. How unfortunate that your results fail to match it.”

lines.japanese: 「ふ……んくっ！！」
lines.english: “Nn... ngh!”

lines.japanese: やがて鳳の指に赤い雫がつたった。俺は以前、やつの指を見せられたことがある。十枚の硬い爪は若い女たちのように伸ばされてこそいなかったが、雄々しい猛禽のように先端が鋭く砥ぎすまされていた。
lines.english: At last, a red drop ran down Otori’s finger. I had seen his hands once before. His nails were not grown long like a young woman’s; instead, all ten ended in points honed sharp as the talons of a proud bird of prey.

lines.japanese: 「おい」
lines.english: “Hey.”
“Haaaah?”

lines.japanese: ぐらん、と鳳の首はだらしなく揺れ、いきなり横に倒れた。頬が肩に付きそうな気の抜けた体勢。獲物を捕えた左腕だけが、別の意識を持った生き物のようになお膂力を揮っていた。
lines.english: Otori’s head gave a loose, ungainly roll and suddenly flopped sideways, his cheek nearly resting on his shoulder. Only his left arm kept bearing down on its prey, like a creature with a mind of its own.

lines.japanese: 森里を放してやれと言うつもりだったが、その狂気じみた眼力に言葉を吸いとられてしまう。息を呑む、という感覚は久しぶりだった。
lines.english: I had meant to tell him to let Morisato go, but the deranged force in his eyes sucked the words out of me. I had almost forgotten what it felt like to have my breath catch.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ？　なんだよ？」
lines.english: “What? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 俺を見上げる不気味な眼球は、あたかも花粉を採取する蜜蜂のようにヴヴン、ヴヴンと揺れていた。
lines.english: The uncanny eye looking up at me quivered *bzzzt, bzzzt*, like a honeybee gathering pollen.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ！　クハハハハ！　なんだファルコン、なァーんて顔してるんだ貴様ァァアハ！　ハハッ、ハハッ、ハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “What is it? Kuhahahaha! What is it, Falcon? Whaaat is that face you're making? Hah! Hah! Hahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 浮かれた酔っ払いというより、気の触れたサディストだ。俺は目の前の男を冷静に観察しているつもりだったが、いつしか嫌悪感から顔をしかめていたようだ。
lines.english: He looked less like a merry drunk than a mad sadist. I thought I was observing the man before me calmly, but at some point disgust must have twisted my face.

lines.japanese: 「ふゥゥゥ……ひゅしるるる……ふゥゥぅ……」
lines.english: “Huuuuuh... hyussshhh... huuuuh...”

lines.japanese: 細かく震える唇の隙間から、ひゅうひゅうと熱い呼気が漏れる。肌は上気し、じっとり汗ばんでいた。
lines.english: Hot breath whistled through the gaps between his finely trembling lips. His skin was flushed and slick with sweat.

lines.japanese: ヤバい。こいつはイカれてる。放っておいたらこのまま森里の血管を突きやぶりかねない。いまや猛禽の蹴爪は、したたる鮮血に紅く燃えている。フレイムバード。
lines.english: Bad. This freak had lost it. If no one stopped him, he might tear straight through Morisato’s blood vessels. The raptor’s talons now burned crimson with dripping blood. Flame Bird.

lines.japanese: 「ふっ……っあ、あ、くぁ……」
lines.english: “Hnh... ah... ah, khah...”

lines.japanese: 「おい翔くん、まじぃって！　ペガも反省してる、もう勘弁してやれよ！」
lines.english: “Kakeru, man, this is bad! Pega’s sorry, too. Come on, let him off already!”

lines.japanese: ギャングの王が、ようやく皇帝に讒言する勇気をしぼりだした。俺も喉のつかえを呑みくだして続いた。
lines.english: At last, the gang’s king scraped together the courage to appeal to his emperor. I swallowed past the knot in my throat and joined him.

lines.japanese: 「鳳。おまえもう少年Ａって歳でもないだろ。それ以上やると面倒ンなる、そろそろ放した方がいんじゃねーの」
lines.english: “Otori. You're too old to be called Juvenile A anymore. Keep going and this'll turn into a real pain in the ass. Maybe it's time to let go.”

lines.japanese: 「なにを？」
lines.english: “Let go of what?”

lines.japanese: 「そいつ。そのロンゲ」
lines.english: “Him. Longhair.”

lines.japanese: 「あァァ？」
lines.english: “Haaah?”

lines.japanese: やつは倒れていた頭をやおら起こし、まるでも照準でもしぼるように眉間の皺を寄せた。白目の中でヴヴヴと跳ねていた眼球が鎮まると、ようやく自らの手にかかっていた従者の姿を認めたようだ。
lines.english: He slowly raised his fallen head and furrowed his brow as if bringing a target into focus. When the eyeball that had been jittering in a field of white finally stilled, he at last seemed to notice the retainer caught in his hand.

lines.japanese: 「ああ……忘れてた……」
lines.english: “Oh... I forgot...”

lines.japanese: 鳳は右手の煙草をたっぷり肺に吸いこんだ。もったいつけた沈黙。
lines.english: Otori drew a lungful from the cigarette in his right hand. A silence drawn out for effect.

lines.japanese: そして、その煙を吐きだすとき、同時に左手をねじるように握りつぶした。
lines.english: Then, as he exhaled the smoke, he gave one final twisting squeeze with his left hand.

lines.japanese: 「づああああああーっ！」
lines.english: “Gyaaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 解放されるその瞬間、森里は獣じみた叫びをあげた。
lines.english: At the very instant he was released, Morisato loosed the cry of an animal.

lines.japanese: 「ペガっ！」
lines.english: “Pega!”

lines.japanese: 「かはっ……はあ！　かはっ……はあ！」
lines.english: “Khah... hah! Khah... hah!”

lines.japanese: 「はあっ！　がふ、ごふっ……ぷは！　ふはっ！　はあっ！　ごほっ……」
lines.english: “Hah! Ghk, khk... p-hah! Hah! Hah! Khh...”

lines.japanese: むせかえりながら空気を吸いこむ憐れな従者の首筋には、赤い染みが滲んでいる。
lines.english: A red stain spread across the neck of the pitiful retainer as he choked and gulped down air.

lines.japanese: 「平気」
lines.english: “You okay?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえええ！」
lines.english: “Shut the fuck up!”

lines.japanese: 森里は俺の言葉を親の仇みたいに拒絶したので、それ以上は何も言わないでおいた。
lines.english: Morisato rejected my concern as though I'd murdered his parents, so I left it there.

lines.japanese: やつはハゲの手を借りてスライドドアを開け、後部座席へ倒れこみながら転がりこんだ。その体を蹴散らして奥へ詰めさせ、鳳がどっかり隣りに座る。
lines.english: With Cue Ball's help he opened the sliding door and tumbled into the rear seat. Otori kicked his crumpled body farther in and dropped heavily into the space beside him.

lines.japanese: 「翔くん、ヘテロ戻る前に病院寄ってくぜ」
lines.english: “Kakeru, we’re stopping at a hospital before we go back to Hetero.”

lines.japanese: やつは後部席へ振りむかず、カーナビのディスプレイを睨みながら一方的に告げた。目的地を最寄りの救急病院に設定しようと、慣れないリモコン操作に難渋しているみたいだった。
lines.english: Without looking toward the back seat, he glared at the navigation display and announced the decision. He seemed to be wrestling with the unfamiliar remote, trying to set the nearest emergency hospital as their destination.

lines.japanese: 「森里、コレやる。病院着くまで傷口おさえとけ」
lines.english: “Morisato, take this. Hold it on the wound till you get to the hospital.”

lines.japanese: 俺は防寒のために巻いていたタオルを作業着の下から引きぬき、窓から放りなげてやった。森里は、はらはらと垂れおちた落ち武者のような長い髪の隙間から、血走った目で俺をねめつけた。
lines.english: I pulled the towel I'd wrapped beneath my work clothes for warmth and tossed it through the window. Through the long strands hanging about his face like a defeated samurai's hair, Morisato glared at me with bloodshot eyes.

lines.japanese: 「気に入らねえ……てめ、マジ気に入らねえっ……！」
lines.english: “I can't stand you... I seriously can't fucking stand you...!”

lines.japanese: 八つ当たりもいいところだ。だが何かに当たりたいんだろう。俺は言いかえさなかった。
lines.english: Talk about misplaced anger. But I guessed he needed something to take it out on, so I didn't answer back.

lines.japanese: やつは震える手で俺のタオルを掴むと、すぐさま鳳の左手を取った。そして、あるじの爪に滲んだ赤黒い汚れを一本一本ぬぐいはじめた。
lines.english: He seized my towel in a trembling hand, then immediately took Otori’s left hand. One by one, he began wiping the dark-red stain from his master’s nails.

lines.japanese: 馬鹿馬鹿しいまでの忠誠心。血まみれの従者に後始末をさせている間じゅう、狂える主君は冷たい微笑をたたえて俺を凝視していた。
lines.english: Loyalty past the point of absurdity. While his bloodied retainer cleaned up after him, the mad lord stared fixedly at me with a cold smile on his face.

lines.japanese: ろくでなしを集めて興じる帝国ごっこも、ここまで来れば大したもんだ。そして俺は、ますますこいつらに関わりたくねぇーと思った。
lines.english: Their little empire game—collecting scum and playing sovereign—was almost impressive once it went this far. And I wanted even less to do with them than before.

lines.japanese: 「ＬＲ、駅のあたりで降ろせ。俺は女でも拾って帰る」
lines.english: “LR. Drop me near the station. I'll pick up a woman and go home.”

lines.japanese: 気まぐれな皇帝が運転席に一言投げた。ハゲはリモコンを放りだして声を荒げた。
lines.english: The capricious emperor tossed the order toward the driver's seat. Cue Ball threw down the remote and raised his voice.

lines.japanese: 「ハア？　またあんたの気まぐれかよ、冗談じゃねえ、このあとのアフターはどうなる！」
lines.english: “Huh? Another goddamn whim? You gotta be kidding me. What happens to the after-party?”

lines.japanese: 「今夜は解散だァ……どいつもこいつも萎えさせる、俺ァすっかり醒めちまった……」
lines.english: “We're done for tonight... Every last one of you has killed the mood. I'm completely over it...”

lines.japanese: 「す、すいません……」
lines.english: “S-sorry...”

lines.japanese: 「オイオイオイ勘弁してくれよ皇帝、そんな簡単に済む話かよ。みんなもう集まってんだぞ、各チームの頭になんて説明すりゃいいんだ」
lines.english: “Come on, Emperor, give me a break. You can't just call it off like that. Everybody's already gathered. What the hell am I supposed to tell the heads of all the teams?”

lines.japanese: 「ありのままを言えよ。納得できねえやつは、勝手に俺抜きでやりゃあいいじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Tell them exactly what happened. Anyone who doesn't like it can carry on without me.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそうかい、じゃあそうするよ！」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah? Fine, that's what we'll do!”

lines.japanese: 「って言いてえとこだけどな……ああクソ、ほんじゃ鳳翔以外の誰が仕切りやるんだってぇ段階で、どうせ衝突しまくってお家騒動になんのは目に見えてンぜ……」
lines.english: “That’s what I’d like to say... Ah, shit. But the second we ask who besides Kakeru Otori is gonna run the thing, everybody’ll start butting heads and we’ll have a full-blown succession war on our hands...”

lines.japanese: ハゲが剥き出しの後頭部をぴしゃぴしゃ叩いてから、やおらシフトレバーに手を置いた。ニュートラルからロウへ押しこむ。しかしアクセルが踏まれる寸前ふたたび鳳が口を開いた。
lines.english: Cue Ball slapped his bare scalp several times, then finally put a hand on the gearshift and pushed it from neutral into low. But just before his foot came down on the gas, Otori spoke again.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあな隼人。奇しくも貴様の望むとおり、夜明けの宴はお流れだ。これで満足か？」
lines.english: “Farewell, Hayato. By a curious turn, the revel before dawn has been called off exactly as you wished. Are you satisfied?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　てめ、んだそのドーダ顔は。そんなん、単におまえの気まぐれじゃねえか。センセー成田君がやめろって言うからやめましたー的な話にまとめてんじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What's with that smug look, asshole? This is just another one of your whims. Don't wrap it up like, ‘Professor Narita told us to stop, so we stopped.’”

lines.japanese: 「だいたいな、おまえが俺の知らないとこでどんだけアホかまそうと、べつに俺ァどーでもいいんだよ。俺ァおまえの妹が迷惑してんぞ、つっただけ」
lines.english: “Besides, I don't give a shit how much stupid crap you pull when I'm not around. All I said was that your sister's paying for it.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハッ、随分とお人好しなことを言うじゃねえか。俺の知る成田隼人は、利もなく他人のために行動するような人間じゃあなかったはずだ」
lines.english: “Hah. How remarkably kindhearted of you. The Hayato Narita I knew was not a man who acted for another's sake without profit.”

lines.japanese: 「……が、その変化は良い兆候だ。クク、情が動けば事態も動くだろう」
lines.english: “...But the change is an auspicious sign. Kuku. Once the heart is moved, events will move with it.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は短くなった煙草を大きく吸いこむと、その残りを火のついたまま、デコピン弾きで窓の外へ飛ばした。
lines.english: Otori took a deep pull from the stub of his cigarette, then sent the still-burning remains flying out the window with a flick of his finger.

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　ンだてめ、その悪玉スマイルは。言いたいことあんならはっきり言えコノヤロウ。奥様向けバラエティみてーなセコい引きしてんじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What's with the villain smile, asshole? If you've got something to say, say it. Don't leave me hanging on some cheap cliffhanger from a daytime variety show.”

lines.japanese: 「つかおい、いまドサクサに紛れてひとん家の現場になに捨てたよ。道路はゴミ箱じゃねーぞコラ」
lines.english: “And hey, what'd you just toss onto somebody else's worksite while no one was looking? The road's not your goddamn trash can.”

lines.japanese: 「出せ」
lines.english: “Drive.”

lines.japanese: 「出せじゃねーだろニワトリ、拾ってけよコレ。おい。おい待てコラ、ポイ捨て禁止条例なめんな」
lines.english: “Don't ‘drive,’ Chicken. Pick this up. Hey. Hey, wait, asshole. Don't fuck with the anti-littering ordinance.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、じゃあな成田君、ペガに免じてお互い今日のことは水に流そうぜ」
lines.english: “All right, see you, Narita. For Pega's sake, let's let bygones be bygones.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　てめ、なに勝手に決め──」
lines.english: “Huh? Who the hell gave you the right to—”

lines.japanese: ──運転手がペダルを踏んだ。後部席でぐったりしていた森里の体が揺れる。
lines.english: —The driver stamped the pedal. Morisato's limp body swayed in the rear seat.

lines.japanese: ハゲの操るワンボックスはいったん豪快なバックで十数メートル下がったあと、豪快なステアさばきで左に切れ、豪快なスリップ音を響かせながら走行車線に戻っていった。
lines.english: Cue Ball’s minivan first shot more than ten meters backward in a spectacular reverse, then cut left with a spectacular wrench of the wheel and skidded back into the open lane with a spectacular shriek of tires.

lines.japanese: 遠ざかる排気音とテールランプ。騒がしい真珠色の風が、ギアを次々切りかえてぐんぐん加速してゆく。
lines.english: Taillights and exhaust receded into the distance. The noisy, pearl-colored wind climbed through the gears and gathered speed.

lines.japanese: 「のヤロウ……条例違反につき二万円以下の罰金だっつーの」
lines.english: “Bastard... That's a fine of up to twenty thousand yen for violating the ordinance.”

lines.japanese: 俺は、あとにぽつねんと残された鳳の吸殻を拾った。やつが去ったあとには、いつだってそれに似た徒労感が残る。
lines.english: I picked up the cigarette butt Otori had left sitting forlornly behind. Whenever he went away, he left me with much the same sense of futility.

lines.japanese: 「あー、わけわかんね」
lines.english: “Ah, none of it makes any damn sense.”

lines.japanese: 俺は白い溜息を吐きだし、真っ赤な誘導灯で肩を叩いた。
lines.english: I let out a white sigh and tapped my shoulder with the bright red baton.

lines.japanese: やけに騒がしい夜だった。ともかく頭をからっぽにして、朝まで労働に精を出すとしよう。
lines.english: It had been one hell of a noisy night. For now, I’d empty my head and work my ass off until morning.
